parameters.pythonCode:
# ========================================
# ATTACHMATE - FILE ANALYSIS
# ========================================

# ----------------------------------------
# GET FILE NAME AND FILE TYPE
# ----------------------------------------

file_name = ""
file_type = "CSV"

if _items:

    binary = _items[0].get("binary", {})

    attachment = binary.get("attachment_0", {})

    file_name = attachment.get("fileName", "")

    extension = attachment.get("fileExtension", "").lower()

    if extension == "xlsx":
        file_type = "Excel (XLSX)"

    elif extension == "csv":
        file_type = "CSV"

    elif extension == "pdf":
        file_type = "PDF"


# ----------------------------------------
# GET ROW DATA
# ----------------------------------------

rows = [item["json"] for item in _items]

if not rows:
    return []


columns = list(rows[0].keys())


# ----------------------------------------
# BASIC INFORMATION
# ----------------------------------------

row_count = len(rows)

column_count = len(columns)


# ----------------------------------------
# MISSING VALUES
# ----------------------------------------

missing_values = {}

for column in columns:

    count = 0

    for row in rows:

        value = row.get(column)

        if value is None or str(value).strip() == "":
            count += 1

    missing_values[column] = count


# ----------------------------------------
# TOTAL MISSING VALUES
# ----------------------------------------

total_missing = sum(missing_values.values())


# ----------------------------------------
# UNIQUE VALUES
# ----------------------------------------

unique_values = {}

for column in columns:

    values = []

    for row in rows:
        values.append(str(row.get(column)))

    unique_values[column] = len(set(values))


# ----------------------------------------
# NUMERIC STATISTICS
# ----------------------------------------

numeric_summary = {}

for column in columns:

    values = []

    for row in rows:

        try:
            value = float(row.get(column))
            values.append(value)

        except:
            pass

    if len(values) > 0:

        numeric_summary[column] = {
            "average": round(
                sum(values) / len(values), 2
            ),
            "minimum": min(values),
            "maximum": max(values)
        }


# ----------------------------------------
# CATEGORY COUNTS
# ----------------------------------------

category_summary = {}

for column in columns:

    counts = {}

    for row in rows:

        value = str(row.get(column))

        if value not in counts:
            counts[value] = 1
        else:
            counts[value] += 1

    # Show category information only
    # when there are manageable categories

    if len(counts) > 1 and len(counts) <= 15:

        category_summary[column] = counts


# ----------------------------------------
# DUPLICATE ROWS
# ----------------------------------------

duplicate_count = (
    row_count
    - len(set(str(row) for row in rows))
)


# ----------------------------------------
# FILE STATUS
# ----------------------------------------

if total_missing > 0 or duplicate_count > 0:

    status = "Issues Found"

else:

    status = "Processed Successfully"


# ----------------------------------------
# COLUMN TEXT
# ----------------------------------------

column_text = ""

for column in columns:

    column_text += (
        "• "
        + str(column)
        + "\n"
    )


# ----------------------------------------
# MISSING VALUE TEXT
# ----------------------------------------

missing_text = ""

for column in missing_values:

    missing_text += (
        "• "
        + str(column)
        + ": "
        + str(missing_values[column])
        + "\n"
    )


# ----------------------------------------
# UNIQUE VALUE TEXT
# ----------------------------------------

unique_text = ""

for column in unique_values:

    unique_text += (
        "• "
        + str(column)
        + ": "
        + str(unique_values[column])
        + "\n"
    )


# ----------------------------------------
# NUMERIC SUMMARY TEXT
# ----------------------------------------

numeric_text = ""

for column in numeric_summary:

    numeric_text += (
        "📌 "
        + str(column)
        + "\n"
    )

    numeric_text += (
        "   Average: "
        + str(
            numeric_summary[column]["average"]
        )
        + "\n"
    )

    numeric_text += (
        "   Minimum: "
        + str(
            numeric_summary[column]["minimum"]
        )
        + "\n"
    )

    numeric_text += (
        "   Maximum: "
        + str(
            numeric_summary[column]["maximum"]
        )
        + "\n"
    )

    numeric_text += "\n"


# ----------------------------------------
# CATEGORY SUMMARY TEXT
# ----------------------------------------

category_text = ""

for column in category_summary:

    category_text += (
        "📌 "
        + str(column)
        + "\n"
    )

    counts = category_summary[column]

    for value in counts:

        category_text += (
            "   "
            + str(value)
            + ": "
            + str(counts[value])
            + "\n"
        )

    category_text += "\n"


# ========================================
# FINAL OUTPUT
# ========================================

summary = {

    # ------------------------------------
    # DASHBOARD DATA
    # ------------------------------------

    "file_name": file_name,

    "file_type": file_type,

    "rows": row_count,

    "columns": column_count,

    "missing_count": total_missing,

    "duplicate_rows": duplicate_count,

    "status": status,


    # ------------------------------------
    # EMAIL REPORT DATA
    # ------------------------------------

    "column_names": columns,

    "column_text": column_text,

    "missing_values": missing_values,

    "missing_text": missing_text,

    "unique_values": unique_values,

    "unique_text": unique_text,

    "numeric_summary": numeric_summary,

    "numeric_text": numeric_text,

    "category_summary": category_summary,

    "category_text": category_text
}


return [{"json": summary}]

data = _items[0]["json"]

text = data.get("text", "")
info = data.get("info", {})

# Find useful information from the extracted text
content_types = ""
purpose = ""
page_size = ""

lines = text.split("\n")

for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()

    if line.startswith("Page Size"):
        page_size = line.replace("Page Size", "").strip()

    elif line.startswith("Content Types"):
        content_types = line.replace("Content Types", "").strip()

    elif line.startswith("Purpose"):
        purpose = line.replace("Purpose", "").strip()

summary = {
    "file_type": "PDF",
    "pages": data.get("numpages"),
    "pdf_version": info.get("PDFFormatVersion"),

    "author": info.get("Author"),
    "title": info.get("Title"),
    "creator": info.get("Creator"),
    "producer": info.get("Producer"),

    "text_available": "Yes" if text.strip() else "No",
    "text_length": len(text),

    "page_size": page_size,
    "content_types": content_types,
    "purpose": purpose
}

return [{"json": summary}]
